observations: Photo 0 is a phone screenshot of a gallery image, with the phone status bar and gallery buttons around it, not a direct camera photo.
It shows a boxy CRT television with a deep rear housing, dark grey/black plastic front bezel and a silver lower strip.
A small round LG logo is faintly visible on the silver strip under the screen in photo 0.
No model number, sticker or rear plate is visible; the word Flatron cannot be read in the photo.
Screen is off and dusty; the set sits on a dirty floor against a blue wall, looks like it has been stored or dumped.
Screen size cannot be measured; it looks like a small to mid size set, roughly 14 to 21 inch class.
Only one photo: no back, no sides, no power-on shot, no view of the cable or the rear cover.

identity.kind: CRT television, not working, scrap for parts or recycling
read_from: photo 0 LG logo on the lower front bezel

claims.claim: It is an LG Flatron TV
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an LG logo on the bezel, so LG is supported, but the Flatron name and model are not readable anywhere in the photo.
The screen is off in photo 0; no power-on clip. It is priced as dead scrap either way.

claims.claim: Sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a dusty, stored CRT set consistent with scrap condition.

claims.claim: Location Oshodi, Lagos; buyer responsible for pickup
claims.evidence: Nothing in the photo shows the location.

risks.risk: Internal parts already stripped (picture tube yoke, main board, flyback, copper degaussing coil removed), which cuts scrap value
risks.proof: Photo of the back with the rear cover off, or a clear shot of the back showing intact screws and housing

risks.risk: Picture tube cracked or the neck broken
risks.proof: Close photo of the screen face in daylight and of the tube neck from the rear
risks.if_unproven: as broken glass, lowest scrap grade

risks.risk: Photo is a gallery screenshot and may not be the seller's own item or current condition
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the TV with a handwritten note bearing today's date and the seller's name
risks.if_unproven: as scrap only, no premium, confirm at pickup before money moves

risks.risk: Screen size unknown, which sets weight and scrap value
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure across the screen diagonal, or the rear label showing the model and size

proof_requests: A fresh photo of the TV with a handwritten note showing today's date
A photo of the back of the set showing the rear cover, screws and the model label
A tape measure across the screen diagonal
A clear close shot of the screen face and the tube neck to rule out cracks
response.reason: Photo 0 shows an LG CRT television sold as scrap, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working, possibly stripped small CRT set for parts or recycling. The model and size are not readable but do not stop a scrap price.
